components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Chamfered safety-orange fill; hazard on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 40px; padding: 0 16px; background: var(--brand, #ff5a1f); color: var(--on-accent, #16181a); border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 0; font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; font-size: 12px; line-height: 16px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; clip-path: polygon(0 0, calc(100% - 8px) 0, 100% 8px, 100% 100%, 0 100%); transition: background-color 150ms; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--hazard, #f2c200); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { clip-path: none; outline: 2px solid var(--ink, #16181a); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 40px; padding: 0 16px; background: transparent; color: var(--ink, #16181a); border: 1px solid var(--ink-muted, #464a4e); border-radius: 0; font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; font-size: 12px; line-height: 16px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: var(--surface-300, #b9b8b2); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ink, #16181a); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Link Button
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; height: 32px; padding: 0 12px; color: var(--brand-text, #8f2c08); text-decoration: none; font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; transition: background-color 150ms; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: var(--surface-300, #b9b8b2); } .ds-btn-ghost .ds-arrow { transition: transform 150ms; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover .ds-arrow { transform: translateX(4px); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ink, #16181a); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Status Tag
components.description: Mono tag; ok tone carries a square marker.
components.css: .ds-tag { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 2px 8px; border: 1px solid var(--ink-muted, #464a4e); color: var(--ink-muted, #464a4e); font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; font-size: 11px; line-height: 16px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-tag-ok { border-color: var(--patina, #2f7f74); color: var(--ink, #16181a); } .ds-tag-ok::before { content: ''; width: 6px; height: 6px; background: var(--patina, #2f7f74); } .ds-tag-hazard { border-color: var(--hazard, #f2c200); background: var(--hazard, #f2c200); color: var(--on-accent, #16181a); }

components.name: Panel
components.description: Ruled plate with corner brackets and a mono header.
components.html:
01 // PROFILESEC.01 ACTIVE
Full-stack engineer.
components.css: .ds-panel { position: relative; background: var(--surface-200, #cbcac5); color: var(--ink, #16181a); border: 1px solid var(--hairline, #8d9093); font-family: 'Barlow', sans-serif; } .ds-c { position: absolute; width: 12px; height: 12px; border: 0 solid var(--ink, #16181a); pointer-events: none; } .ds-tl { top: -1px; left: -1px; border-top-width: 2px; border-left-width: 2px; } .ds-tr { top: -1px; right: -1px; border-top-width: 2px; border-right-width: 2px; } .ds-bl { bottom: -1px; left: -1px; border-bottom-width: 2px; border-left-width: 2px; } .ds-br { bottom: -1px; right: -1px; border-bottom-width: 2px; border-right-width: 2px; } .ds-panel-h { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; padding: 8px 16px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--hairline, #8d9093); font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; font-size: 12px; line-height: 16px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-meta { color: var(--ink-muted, #464a4e); font-weight: 400; } .ds-panel-b { padding: 16px; font-size: 15px; line-height: 22px; }

components.name: Readout
components.description: Mono instrument value over a ruler-tick strip.
components.css: .ds-readout { display: inline-flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; min-width: 152px; color: var(--ink, #16181a); } .ds-r-l { color: var(--ink-muted, #464a4e); font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; font-size: 11px; line-height: 16px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.08em; } .ds-r-v { font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; font-size: 32px; line-height: 32px; font-weight: 500; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-r-u { margin-left: 4px; color: var(--ink-muted, #464a4e); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 400; } .ds-r-t { display: block; height: 8px; margin-top: 4px; background: repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, var(--ink-muted, #464a4e) 0 1px, transparent 1px 8px); }

components.name: Nav Bar
components.description: Gunmetal plate with indexed mono links and theme switch.
components.html: 01 ABOUT02 PROJECTST+00:01:12
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 24px; padding: 12px 24px; background: var(--gunmetal, #2c3338); color: var(--on-gunmetal, #d9d8d4); font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.08em; } .ds-nav a { color: inherit; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav a:hover { color: var(--brand-text, #ff8a57); } .ds-nav-t { margin-left: auto; opacity: 0.8; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-seg { display: flex; border: 1px solid rgba(217,216,212,0.6); } .ds-seg button { padding: 4px 8px; background: transparent; color: inherit; border: 0; font: inherit; font-size: 11px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-seg button[aria-pressed=true] { background: var(--on-gunmetal, #d9d8d4); color: var(--gunmetal, #2c3338); }

narrative.overview: The site reads as a ruggedized piece of survey and telemetry gear. Every mark looks like it measures something: coordinates, local time, elapsed mission time, build number, project status. Panels are ruled plates with corner brackets, values sit over ruler-tick strips, and the hero is backed by graph paper with a radar sweep. Two themes share one token set: Concrete (light) and Foundry (dark), each carrying exactly one safety-orange signal per view.
keyCharacteristics: Square steel geometry; the single flourish is an 8px chamfer.
Mono uppercase labels everywhere data lives; condensed display type for names and titles.
One brand fill per view; status colors always paired with a word or marker.
Flat surfaces separated by hairlines and corner brackets.
Mechanical, wipe-and-tick motion; glitch is opt-in and visitor-controlled.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Safety orange fills one thing per view. A second orange fill means the first one stops meaning anything.

rules.name: The Word-With-Color Rule
rules.body: Hazard, patina and signal-red never carry meaning alone; pair each with a word or a square marker.

rules.name: The Mono-Means-Data Rule
rules.body: If it's a value, a status, a code, or a control, it's set in IBM Plex Mono uppercase. Prose stays in Barlow.

rules.name: The Plate Steel Rule
rules.body: Layers are separated by rules and brackets, never by shadow. If something needs to lift, give it a surface step and a border.

dos: Do keep safety orange to one fill per view; use rust text for orange words.
Do set labels, values, statuses and controls in IBM Plex Mono uppercase at 0.08em tracking.
Do separate layers with hairlines, corner brackets, and surface steps.
Do keep the terminal voice in labels (STATUS //, PRJ_00, SEC.01 ACTIVE).
Do make motion mechanical: clip-path wipes, ticks, typed text; respect reduced motion.
donts: Don't add shadows, gradients, or glows.
Don't round corners past 4px, or use pills.
Don't show status with color alone.
Don't use real military insignia or loaded emblems as ornament; stick to neutral instrument forms.
Don't reference primitive tokens (--ni-*) in components; use the semantic tokens.
